$comment: Which BC versions the code pillar snapshots in full. Older versions are kept as diffs only (v0.2+). Base App exists in microsoft/BCApps only from 29.0; 28.x Base App comes from StefanMaron's history repos.

code.$comment: What the code job extracts per snapshot source (PLAN 4.6, D27). W1 apps in full; countries as overlays (objects new or changed against W1). BCApps carries every layer in one checkout and stacks them (layers_config.json: AT on DACH on W1, each layer may exclude inherited files); regional layers (APAC, DACH, NA) are bases, not countries. `apps` = Microsoft's first-party apps (Shopify, Power BI Reports, ...), their own snapshot data/code/<major>/apps (no tests, no demo data), kept out of W1 so version diffs compare like with like. Code History has one complete branch per country, so its list is explicit. `country_apps` = a country's own extension apps (src/Apps/<layer>/*/app), expanded for every layer of its chain after W1, so US gets NA's apps and its own, like its base-app view; DK and IN ship their whole localization this way (D58). `country_apps_exclude` drops the demo-data apps from a country view: Contoso sample data is not localization, and it would inflate every narrative and the heatmap.
